summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in the ControlCode union; rich/control.py adds the title sequence format (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title classmethod with docstring; rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor, returning True when written on a terminal and False otherwise; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one SET_WINDOW_TITLE branch calling term.set_title with the control's second item. Tests added in tests/test_console.py (skipped on Windows), tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. CHANGELOG.md gained an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests and Black were not run, per instructions; verification was by reading only.
